words: ok we need to get the living creatue and highest ally form to look more natural. They are too geometric at the moment.

we're gonna need dramatically stronger contrasts between the elemental living creatures and highest ally forms. I want to explore what kind of detailing will communicate the elemental quality. I Tmight even be as simple as having an elemental aura around them, but yeah the shifts of the leaves on the back isn't quite doing it for me. but we're headed in the right direction

Ok these are a lot better! The issue now is with the eyes. They should probably have the same eyes but with different eye color (pupil) because the eyes ar being rendered as orbs they are looking quite scary and weird across the different models. The spikes in the fire turtle shell don't look very natural in comparison to the other. The wood one is probably the best. Water has the right idea but the drops spinning around the turtle are spilled we'd want them to be strands of lightweight water effects
